D1.text:
Send a compressed re-expression. 
The data owner signs the release. 
The receiving peer verifies the standing in the trust graph. 
The document remains unchanged. 
The counterparty receives a telling with chosen fidelity. 
Mathematics establishes the invariant core. 
Minimization proves the released content. 
Contracts define intent and purpose limitation.

D2.text: Content-addressed compressions, representing data’s core, are permitted. Harm is limited by the agreed-upon fidelity, verified through trust relationships. Proof of release establishes the scope of disclosure, ensuring accountability.

D3.text: Three parties establish a one-way map. A predicate over a set defines a compressed re-expression. Cardinality is one-to-one. Quantities are defined by fidelity and trust graph standing. VPK’s substrate is a constant.

entailment.why: The telling implies a one-way map is established, while the source states documents are sent (and returned, implicitly).
